# Test vectors of emberwave's encoder: scripts/gen_encoder_vectors.sh makes
# them from this list and tests/encoder.rs checks them. One per line:
# name pattern width height chroma frames bytes-per-frame
scene_200x120_420 scene 200 120 420 2 6000
gradient_200x120_420 gradient 200 120 420 2 60000
noise_192x136_420_lowrate noise 192 136 420 2 12000
scene_131x67_444 scene 131 67 444 2 4000
solid_160x96_420 solid 160 96 420 1 40000
# Dropping most planes: blocks drop up to all they may.
scene_200x120_420_tiny scene 200 120 420 2 300
# Twelve frames: the sequence number wraps from 7 to 0.
solid_64x64_420_wrap solid 64 64 420 12 4000
# The smallest frames: the start of frame header and the blocks of the
# coarsest level, which every frame carries, as small as they get.
noise_64x64_444_smallest noise 64 64 444 2 152
